description:
HushTelegram v0.0.20 targets telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the Google Play build 13.1.0 (org.telegram.messenger) with 67 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. This release moves to Telegram 13.1.0 and Morphe's 2.0 patcher, and it adds four switches from your reports.

If Telegram turns down your login code with API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD, that's it refusing the public API ID every patched build carries, the Play one included. Register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 1378 runtime tests passed locally. All 488 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 67 patches applied to Telegram 13.1.0 without forcing, both telegram.org's build (version code 72299) and the Google Play build (version code 72291), and the release receipt checked each patched app's manifest, native libraries and alignment.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 or the Google Play build 13.1.0. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Coming from an earlier HushTelegram, patch 13.1.0 and install it over your current build with the same signing key. New installs uninstall the stock Telegram and keep the manager's signing key for updates.

### What's new

* **Telegram:** Moved to Telegram 13.1.0, both telegram.org's build (version code 72299) and the Google Play build (version code 72291). Every patch carried over as it was.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram now builds on Morphe's 2.0 patcher, so this release needs **Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer**. Update Manager first, then patch. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 1.19.0 or newer. The patch count is the same, and every patch still applies to both 13.1.0 builds.
* **Telegram:** The HushTelegram settings home page gets you to the settings sooner. The seven pages of switches now sit right under the status card, and the header, the gaps between cards, the section titles and the page rows all take less room. **Quick setups** moved to the Settings backup page and **Lock HushTelegram settings** to the Pause page under More settings. Search finds both, and they work like before. The long press that hid Quick setups is gone, and so is its **Quick setups on the home page** row.
* **Telegram:** Locking the HushTelegram settings by mistake no longer costs you a day. For 10 minutes after you lock them, the row reads **Unlock now** and one tap opens them again. After that, unlocking takes the usual 24 hours. Changing the phone's clock or restarting the phone ends those 10 minutes early. (#23)
* **Telegram:** Save downloaded files has a new switch under it, **Also save from chats that don't allow saving**, and it starts off. With it on, files and songs from chats whose owner turned off saving get a copy in Download/Telegram too. That's for chats where the owner doesn't mind you keeping things. Secret chats and self-destructing media still stay inside Telegram. (#29)
* **Telegram:** Save downloaded files now covers the files and songs Telegram downloads on its own, too. Before, a file that auto-download fetched while its chat was closed stayed in Telegram even with the switch on, and only files downloaded in an open chat got a copy. Those now go to Download/Telegram under their own names, and chats that don't allow saving follow the same switch as everything else. (#29)
* **Telegram:** Keep deleted messages gets a second switch, **Show deleted in red**. Off by default. Turn it on and the word "deleted" next to a kept message's time turns red, so those messages stand out while you scroll. The time keeps its usual color and the bubble stays the same size. (#25)
* **Telegram:** **Hide Contacts tab** has one more switch on the Chat list page, **Hide new message button**. It hides the round pencil button on the chat list. The story camera button, the archive, your folders and search all work as before, and you start a new chat from the menu or from search instead. It's off until you turn it on, and the change shows after a restart. (#22)
* **Telegram:** **Keep videos muted on volume keys** has a second switch on the Playback page, **Full screen videos turn either way**. Telegram puts a full screen video on one landscape side and leaves it there, so turning the phone the other way shows the picture upside down. With this switch on, the video follows your phone to either side, even with auto-rotate off. It starts off. (#27)

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Black and white launch logo
patches.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Change sticker size
patches.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable call debug upload
patches.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable draft link previews
patches.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable pull to archive
patches.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable update checks
patches.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches.name: Exact numbers
patches.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Faster downloads
patches.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Folders by chat type
patches.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide Send as button
patches.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide Stories
patches.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide phone number
patches.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide popular apps
patches.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. Two more switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones.

patches.name: Hide promotional banners
patches.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide recommendations
patches.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide time on stickers
patches.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide translate bar
patches.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Holiday look all year
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

options.description: The name under the icon, up to 30 characters. Leave it empty to keep Telegram.

patches.name: HushTelegram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Message times with seconds
patches.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Reveal spoilers
patches.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Save downloaded files
patches.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Translate with an outside service
patches.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Use normal paste
patches.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

options.description: A Google Maps key for Android apps, made in your own Google Cloud project. Limit it to Telegram's package name and your signing certificate (SHA-1).

patches.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

options.description: The number shown as App api_id at my.telegram.org/apps. Fill in the API hash too, or leave both empty.
The 32-character code shown as App api_hash at my.telegram.org/apps. Keep it private, and fill in the API ID too.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide Stories
patches.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide phone number
patches.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide popular apps
patches.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. Two more switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones.

patches.name: Hide promotional banners
patches.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide recommendations
patches.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide time on stickers
patches.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide translate bar
patches.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Holiday look all year
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

options.description: The name under the icon, up to 30 characters. Leave it empty to keep Telegram.

patches.name: HushTelegram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Message times with seconds
patches.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Reveal spoilers
patches.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Save downloaded files
patches.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Translate with an outside service
patches.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Use normal paste
patches.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

options.description: A Google Maps key for Android apps, made in your own Google Cloud project. Limit it to Telegram's package name and your signing certificate (SHA-1).

patches.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

options.description: The number shown as App api_id at my.telegram.org/apps. Fill in the API hash too, or leave both empty.
The 32-character code shown as App api_hash at my.telegram.org/apps. Keep it private, and fill in the API ID too.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

release_notes:
HushTelegram v0.0.9 has 25 patches for telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`) and the official Telegram beta 12.10.7 (`org.telegram.messenger.beta`), up from 22 in v0.0.8. Twenty-three are selected by default. The two credential patches take your own values, so they stay off until you pick them.

## What's new

* **Telegram:** Repair Firebase push registration now works on slower phones. Firebase starts its first Installations request while Telegram is still starting, and on a slow phone that request could get there before HushTelegram's settings were ready. It then went out with the re-signed certificate, Firebase refused it, and no push token was saved. The request now waits for the settings, up to 10 seconds, on Firebase's own background thread. The diagnostic report counts requests that waited and any that still went out early.
* **Telegram:** The beta target is now telegram.org's current 12.10.7 build, version code 71179, which replaced build 71159. Every patch applies and passes its fixture tests on it.
* **Telegram:** The README says every way into HushTelegram settings (Telegram's own Settings, a long-press on the Telegram icon, or App info), and walks through the my.telegram.org form for your own API ID, including what causes "Incorrect app name!".
* **Telegram:** Three independent switches add plain-text paste, copyable local user and chat IDs, and a way to stop double-tap reactions. They start off. Pause restores the stock behavior, and the existing clipboard and explicit reaction actions stay available.
* **Telegram:** Pause, Settings backup and Diagnostics now have separate pages with shorter headings. Search still reaches every control, and all five translations include the new page names.
* **Telegram:** New Year look all year now puts Telegram's Santa hat over the chat list logo. It follows the logo's bounds and color so it stays visible in light and dark themes. Other titles keep their original drawing path. Changed title geometry getters refuse before patching. The switch remains off by default, and Pause restores Telegram's seasonal behavior.
* **Telegram:** External links now recognize browser aliases that Android enables at runtime, even when their manifest default is disabled. Disabled or private components stay excluded, and the browser chooser keeps its existing order.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram settings now opens from a row in Telegram's own Settings. Repeated taps share one screen, and the launcher and Android App-info entries remain available. Partial patch selections show only their installed controls. Changed incoming item registers or callback casts refuse before any hook is edited.
* **Telegram:** Changing the registered API ID now refreshes the native connection identity for every valid ID. IDs that differ by 128 no longer share a marker. Updates also stay distinct from the previous marker scheme, without changing saved account keys or the app version. Changed native argument shapes refuse before either credential is edited.

### Tooling

* **Tooling:** Builds use Morphe patcher 1.15.1, which brings faster fingerprint matching and signing, and stricter DEX path checks. Morphe Manager 1.34.0 is the first stable Manager that carries it, so the README now asks for 1.34.0 or newer. Fixture checks use the desktop CLI 1.18.1.
* **Tooling:** The source-ledger paragraph now identifies v0.0.8 as the published bundle and distinguishes newer source changes.
* **Tooling:** A bounded selection matrix checks both declared Telegram builds 41 ways each, from the defaults and the full catalog down to single patches and bad credential options. It checks each build's dependencies, minimum Android version, preserved resources, native libraries and settings switches. Configured credentials must change only their own values and the native connection version marker. Mutation controls reject missing, duplicated or altered markers.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get Telegram **12.10.6** from [telegram.org/android](https://telegram.org/android) by tapping Download Telegram (it saves as plain `Telegram.apk`), or the [official beta](https://telegram.org/dl/android/apk-public-beta) **12.10.7**, and patch it. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from v0.0.8? Patch again and install over it with the same Morphe Manager signing key. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put one over the other. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram won't send you a login code, register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps). Use only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select **Use registered Telegram API credentials**, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.
7. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

## Validation

579 runtime tests and 303 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 25 patches applied without forcing to Telegram 12.10.6 and to the 12.10.7 beta, build 71179. The dependency advisory check passed. On an Android 9 emulator slowed down to match the push report, this build saved a push token in all seven runs. The patched beta started, opened HushTelegram settings and registered for push.
repoDescription: HushTelegram v0.0.4: Morphe patches that take sponsored messages and search ads out of Telegram and keep its usage reports on your phone. 4 patches for Telegram 12.10.6.
